title: Meerut Woman's Husband Killed by Snake in Mysterious Circumstances
summary: A woman in Meerut, India, has been accused of killing her husband with a snake. The incident occurred after the couple had a disagreement, and the wife allegedly used a venomous snake to kill her husband while he was asleep. The police are investigating the case, which has raised questions about the circumstances surrounding the death.
